patterns.name: credential-in-code
patterns.reason: A password, secret, token or API key written into the code reaches everyone who can read the repo.
patterns.fix: Read the value from the environment or the app's credential store instead.

patterns.name: private-key-in-code
patterns.reason: A private key written into the code lets anyone who can read the repo act as its owner.
patterns.fix: Keep the key in the app's credential store or a secrets manager and load it at runtime.

patterns.name: connection-string-with-password
patterns.reason: A connection string written into the code carries its password to everyone who can read the repo.
patterns.fix: Read the connection string, or at least its password, from the environment.

patterns.name: cloud-access-key-id
patterns.reason: A cloud access key id written into the code is half of a credential and usually sits beside the other half.
patterns.fix: Remove the key, rotate it, and read it from the environment or the provider's credential chain.
